Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  OF THE JUNE 29, 2020 SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant
to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called to
order by Mayor McGowan at 6:31 P.M. on June 29, 2020, notice having been given with affidavit
thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information to provide
public input:

  BY COMPUTER:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82331228760

  Zoom Meeting ID: 823 3122 8760 or

  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 823 3122 8760#

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-21

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O20-746

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:

  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson, Kao and Lozzi

ABSENT:
  None

ALSO PRESENT:

  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Hogin, Treasurer Ying, Community
  Development/Public Works Director Rukavina, Planning Manager Rindge, Interim Police
  Chief Dreiling, Police Captain Best, City Clerk Chaney

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
June 29, 2020
 Mayor McGowan asked City Manager Guglielmo to provide and update on pending closures by the
Department of Public Health for the Fourth of July Holiday weekend. Community
Development/Public Works Director Rukavina noted that the closures will begin on July 2 nd due to
the Holiday Closure on July 3rd.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

NEW BUSINESS

  1) Approval of Amendment No. 3 to the Professional Services Agreement with HR Green
  Pacific, Inc.

  Community Development/Public Works Director Rukavina reported.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Kao, Seconded by Councilmember Davidson to
  approve Amendment No. 3 to the Professional Services Agreement with HR Green
  Pacific, Inc. The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Kao, Davidson, McGowan
  NOES:  Lozzi, Kemps

  2) Approval of the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Budget and Capital Plan and Adopt: R20-21
  Adopting the 2020-2021 Annual Budget and Setting the Limitation of Expenditures
  Resolution, and R20-22 Establishing the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Appropriations Limit.

  City Manager Guglielmo presented and noted a correction to Resolution R20-22.

  The following individual addressed the City Council: Desiree Myers.

  The City Council requested that a department level line item review be conducted within 120
  days, including a review of all contracts.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Lozzi, Seconded by Mayor McGowan to approve
  the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Budget and Capital Plan subject to a department review and
  reevaluation in 120 days and Adopt: R20-21 Adopting the 2020-2021 Annual Budget
  and Setting the Limitation of Expenditures Resolution, and R20-22 as amended
  Establishing the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Appropriations Limit. The motion carried by
  the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:  None

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Seconded by Councilmember Kao to adjourn
  the meeting at 8:24 p.m. The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:  None

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
June 29, 2020
